name.value: Fas Gas Plus Chevron Fort St John

description.value: A Chevron-branded fuel station and convenience store on Alaska Road North in Fort Saint John, sitting along the route to the Alaska Highway. For touring cyclists heading north or resupplying in the Peace River region, it is one of the larger-format fuel stops in the area, tagged in OSM as accommodating large vehicles and offering diesel alongside regular grades.
